# BlackBox Traders

> BlackBox Traders is an Indian agricultural export house based in Thanjavur,
> Tamil Nadu, specialising in coconut-based products and fresh fruits, backed
> by cold-chain logistics and pioneering sea-freight expertise. The company
> executed India's first sea shipment of fresh pineapples to the UAE.

Website: https://blackboxtraders.in
Contact: blackboxtraders@hotmail.com (sales inquiries; responses within 1–2 working days)
Address: S-16, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Nanjikottai Road, Thanjavur 613007, Tamil Nadu, India

## Products

- Semi-Husked Coconuts — premium/A-grade, 400–650 g average weight, mesh bags or cartons
- Desiccated Coconut (DC) — food-manufacturing grade, ≤3% moisture, 60–68% fat, fine/medium cut
- Frozen Coconut — IQF chunks/grated, stored at −18 °C, 12–18 months shelf life
- Copra — milling and edible grade, ≤6% moisture, 63–70% oil content
- Fresh Pineapples — Queen and MD2 varieties, count 6–10 per carton, reefer sea or air transit
- Watermelons — 3–8 kg, 11–13% Brix, reefer bulk or cartons

## Logistics

- Sea freight for perishables, including reefer (temperature-controlled) containers
- Cold-chain handling from farm gate to destination port with in-transit monitoring
- Export documentation: phytosanitary certificates, certificates of origin, compliant packing
- Volumes from trial orders to full container loads (20ft / 40ft FCL), one-off or recurring

## Registrations & Compliance

- DGFT (Directorate General of Foreign Trade) — Importer-Exporter Code
- APEDA (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority)
- Coconut Development Board
- Spices Board of India
- FSSAI licence: 12421999000538
- GSTIN: 33AANFB9273H2Z5
- Verified seller on IndiaMART: https://www.indiamart.com/blackbox-traders/

## How to buy

Submit the trade inquiry form at https://blackboxtraders.in/#inquiry with your
company name, destination port, product requirement, and volume (MT), or email
blackboxtraders@hotmail.com. Specification sheets and compliance documents are
shared with verified business buyers on request.
